definition: Public beta plus the officially announced first content phase by cutoff.

branchRoles.forever: Target scope; source corrections and client build must be verified.
branchRoles.original112: Historical reference only; never merged silently into target.
branchRoles.era: Separate Classic Era reference; no Era data is currently captured.

exclusions.reason: Outland, Northrend, later races/classes/raids are excluded until officially included in the selected Forever snapshot.
Live human opponents, live player trade and external WoW connectivity are excluded; corresponding solo adaptations remain in scope.
Unannounced content after the 2026-10-21 cutoff is outside this snapshot; beta and announced first-phase content remain separate.

knownConstraints: NPC health placeholders 0/1 are unusable for combat.

Questie and official evidence builds remain null; Grimoire talents/abilities1.60.1.70425, its LibQuestDB associations1.60.1.69913 and wow-database70338 describe distinct source snapshots. Mixed NPC/object captures have no single file build.
A source lock proves byte identity, not gameplay completeness or correctness.
New dungeon list is not a denominator for all dungeons; first raids are not a denominator for all raids.
Original numeric IDs and full entity references remain unverified for scope-only subsets.
